screens_note: Real captures of the firmware's unlock screen, taken over one demo set of entries (committed to the firmware repository on 2026-10-20) and published on kleidos.dev. Each native file is a byte copy of the firmware repository's file under 'from'; 'scale' is the enlarged copy's whole multiple.
photos_note: The owner's own photographs, given for publication. Each file under press-kit/photos/ is written once by kleidos_brand.photos.clean from the camera's file, which is not kept: upright, sRGB, every metadata segment gone. four-boards then had classic corrections only, nothing generated: white balance taken from the white cases, exposure and contrast raised slightly, a light unsharp mask and a 3 % crop on each edge to 4:3. The narrower copies are built from it.

four-boards.what: four boards on a wooden table, each running an earlier build of Kleidos: the M5Stack Cardputer ADV and the M5Stack Core2 v1.3 on the list of credentials, the M5StickS3 on one credential, the LILYGO T-Deck Plus asking for the passphrase

alt.en: Four boards running Kleidos on a wooden table: an M5Stack Cardputer ADV and an M5Stack Core2 v1.3 showing the list of credentials, an M5StickS3 showing one credential's details, and a LILYGO T-Deck Plus asking for the passphrase. The screens show an earlier build of Kleidos.
alt.es: Cuatro placas con Kleidos sobre una mesa de madera: una M5Stack Cardputer ADV y una M5Stack Core2 v1.3 con la lista de credenciales, una M5StickS3 con los datos de una credencial y una LILYGO T-Deck Plus que pide la contraseña de desbloqueo. Las pantallas son de una versión anterior de Kleidos.
